purpose: Blueprint for the public/customer-facing GitHub App that owns the ANPOS GitHub Marketplace listing, supports Marketplace account reconciliation, and provides the Community read-only ANPOS Repository Readiness / Conformance Audit. This file is not an App registration and contains no credentials.
permission_rule: Community v1 uses the narrow multiple-single-files read permission for exactly the ten approved ANPOS control files plus GitHub's baseline metadata read. The Marketplace App installation proves the approved consent surface; actual audit reads are performed with the authenticated GitHub user access token so repository access remains user-bound. Do not request broad repository Contents access for the readiness audit.
security_requirements: This App must be distinct from the private Vendor Distribution GitHub App.
Generate its private key and OAuth client secret only in GitHub and store them in an approved secret manager; never commit them.

Configure the marketplace_purchase webhook from the GitHub Marketplace listing Webhook page, point it at /api/webhooks/github/marketplace, use a strong secret, and verify signatures before processing payloads. Do not subscribe to marketplace_purchase as a normal GitHub App webhook event.
Do not grant vendor private-template Administration permission to this customer-facing App.
Community repository audit must not read application source code; it may read only the approved single_file_paths after the target installation permission set is verified.
A repository audit must authenticate the requesting GitHub user and read the approved files with that user access token; an installation_id or repository string alone is not user authorization.
Marketplace Setup URL must initiate a PKCE-protected OAuth flow. The setup installation_id is untrusted until the resulting authenticated user token is verified against that installation.
Keep request_oauth_on_install disabled because the Marketplace purchase flow requires an explicit Setup URL. Use the Setup URL to start OAuth instead.
Community v1 keeps the GitHub access token only inside an encrypted short-lived HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax session cookie and deliberately does not persist the refresh token.
Do not claim Marketplace publication, installation count, publisher verification, pricing, or free-plan activation from this blueprint.
Re-check current GitHub Marketplace and GitHub App visibility/permission requirements immediately before registration/listing submission.

marketplace_listing_webhook.rule: Configure this webhook from the GitHub Marketplace listing Webhook page after the draft listing exists. Do not model marketplace_purchase as a normal GitHub App event subscription.
